response: This is the kind of nonsense we get from the left these days. Introduced as part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, the proposed legislation would require guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified into illegal machine guns and would establish criminal penalties. Make no mistake, this is an attempt to further restrict the rights of law-abiding citizens and manufacturers under the false flag of preventing illegal modifications. Rather than promoting personal responsibility and cracking down on those who actually break the law, they're targeting the tools that Americans have traditionally used for self-defense and maintaining order in their communities. We must resist these attacks on our national values and the family's ability to protect itself.
